svg.title: Source photograph, one-object reconstruction and split reconstruction
svg.desc: Actual saved renders from one scripted experiment. Figure colour error decreases from 26.17 to 18.47 out of 255, but side-view gaps increase from 926 to 2055 pixels at 40 degrees.

g.text: Keep the face. Inspect the tradeoff.
One photograph, scripted case. Source-view detail improves while alternate-view gaps increase.
